title: feat: run a herdr server in the pollinations sandbox templates
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added herdr 0.9.3 to both sizes of the pollinations sandbox template, pinned to its GitHub asset digest with update checks disabled. In polli CLI 0.1.44, each `ssh <id>.polli` bootstrap starts or reuses a herdr server as `user` when `/usr/local/bin/herdr` is present; other templates are unchanged. Agents and shell processes running in herdr panes can survive SSH disconnects and sandbox pause/resume, and `herdr agent list` shows their state. Added a note to the sandbox docs.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli watches a tiny agent tending a code-plant inside a glowing herdr pane while an unplugged SSH cable rests nearby; a single retro terminal shows the agent still working. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny tool belt and is small-to-medium within the scene, sharing the frame without dominating it, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
